# Type & titles: 71 effects

<!-- Generated by `pnpm catalog:meta` from the catalog (src/catalog/lazy.test.ts): do not edit. -->

Categories: text, morph, broadcast, annotation, sticker. Each line: `id` (kind) what it looks like, what it takes (a subject: image, video, svg, text, mask, path, audio), the text controls words go in, how it answers the pointer, how it suits video, whether it is an overlay, its presets and tags. Check an id before using it: `flair effects --search <words>` or `getEffectMeta(id)`.

## text

- `light-strand-text` (shader) Tall, heavy letters built from hundreds of fine strands of light, steel blue to white, that fall into place from top to bottom, the letters' cores first and their edges last, then curve along the edges, brightening and fading as light slides down them, with a few warm threads running through and a glow along the lower edges. Takes image, svg, text, mask. Overlay. Presets: On black, Gold, Emerald, Fine. Tags: text, title, light, streak, line, fibre, glow, hero, tech, overlay.
- `shader-text` (shader) A title filled with a living texture (plasma, fire, caustics or liquid chrome), with a soft glow and outline. Takes image, svg, text, mask. Presets: Inferno, Pool, Chrome. Tags: text, title, plasma, fire, chrome, glow.
- `echo-text` (shader) A title trailed by copies of its own outline in two alternating colours, fanning out behind it and folding back in a ripple. Set the outline width to 0 for solid stacked copies. Takes image, svg, text, mask. Presets: Outline trail, Solid stack, Zoom out, Ghost. Tags: text, title, echo, outline, trail, repeat, kinetic, bold, recap, story, loop.
- `stretch-text` (shader) A title whose letters are pulled tall along a cut line, the stretch travelling across the word in a wave, like type drawn on a variable-height axis. Takes image, svg, text, mask. Presets: Wave, Two tone, Equaliser, Breathe. Tags: text, title, stretch, variable, kinetic, wave, bold, recap, story, loop.
- `glass-text` (shader) A title cast in glass over a picture, bending and splitting what is behind it, while a beam of light sweeps through the letters and breaks into a faint rainbow at their edges. Takes image, video, svg, text, mask. Video: filter. Presets: Clear, Frosted, Ice, Amber, Prism sweep, Still. Tags: text, title, glass, refraction, prism, rainbow, light-sweep, image.
- `chrome-text` (shader) A title in polished or brushed metal: its bevels reflect a studio sky and dark ground split by a bright horizon, and a glint sweeps across the letters. Takes image, svg, text, mask. Overlay. Presets: Gold, Brushed steel, Synthwave, Rose gold, With background. Tags: text, title, chrome, metal, mirror, reflection, gold, 80s, overlay.
- `iridescent-text` (shader) A title in rainbow chrome: thin-film colours swirl over bevelled letters with bright white rims, a soft rainbow halo, and star glints twinkling at the edges. Takes image, svg, text, mask. Overlay. Presets: Pearl, Oil slick, No glints, With background. Tags: text, title, iridescent, holographic, chrome, rainbow, glossy, hero, overlay.
- `drip-text` (vector) A chunky outlined title popping in, then oozing slime drips from its letters; Inline sets it in a line of text. Takes text. Words go in `word`. Presets: Slime, Molten gold. Tags: title, text, drip, slime, y2k, headline.
- `typewriter` (vector) Letters typed out one at a time behind a block caret, which then blinks. Takes text. Words go in `text`. Presets: Terminal, Paper. Tags: text, title, typing, terminal, caption.
- `scramble-text` (vector) Random glyphs flickering, then settling into the real word letter by letter, left to right. Takes text. Words go in `text`. Presets: Matrix, Amber. Tags: text, title, decode, hacker, cyber, reveal.
- `kinetic-stagger` (vector) Each letter springs up into place in turn, rising, turning and overshooting, then an underline sweeps beneath. Takes text. Words go in `text`. Presets: Poster, Midnight. Tags: text, title, kinetic, typography, headline, intro.
- `caption-word-bounce` (vector) A caption's words spring up one after another, each overshooting in scale with an elastic wobble before it settles. Takes text. Words go in `text`. Presets: Bubblegum, Clean, Lime pop. Tags: caption, subtitle, text, kinetic, typography, social, words, bounce.

## morph

- `feature-morph` (shader) The classic face morph: two pictures warp so five matching points (eyes, mouth, chin, hairline) meet while they cross-fade. Takes image, video, svg. Video: stills. Presets: Show points. Tags: morph, face, warp, image, transition.
- `silhouette-morph` (shader) One silhouette or logo flowing into another as a gooey blob, its colour blending from the first shape's to the second's. Takes image, svg, text, mask. Presets: Hello → World, Blobby. Tags: morph, shape, logo, goo, blob, text.
- `shape-morph` (vector) Any two SVG paths morphing into each other and back, their fill and outline colours blending along. Takes path. Presets: Ink, Heart to drop, Outline. Tags: morph, shape, path, icon, logo.
- `icon-toggle` (vector) A round button whose icon morphs between two states (play and pause, menu and close, sun and moon) with a little pop. Presets: Play / pause, Menu / close, Plus / check, Day / night, Like. Tags: morph, icon, ui, button, toggle, micro-interaction.
- `morph-sequence` (vector) One shape flowing from circle to star to heart to hexagon and round again, its colour changing with each. Presets: Pastel, Mono. Tags: morph, shape, loop, background, playful.
- `gooey-morph` (vector) A cluster of liquid drops melting into a star, splitting into two blobs and beading back into drops. Presets: Lava, Slime, Ink. Tags: morph, gooey, liquid, metaball, blob, loop.
- `particle-morph` (vector) A shape bursting into dots along its outline that swirl across and settle into a second shape, then back. Takes path. Presets: Confetti, Embers, Circle to square. Tags: morph, particles, dots, shape, logo, reveal.
- `digit-morph` (vector) A number counting from one value to another, each digit's stroke bending smoothly into the next. Presets: Countdown, New year, Thin. Tags: morph, number, counter, countdown, kpi, digits.

## sticker

- `holo-foil-sticker` (shader) A die-cut sticker cut from any shape's outline, with a thick white border, a drop shadow and holographic foil whose rainbow and sparkles shift as the pointer tilts it. Takes image, svg, text, mask. Answers hover, pointer. Overlay. Presets: Heart, Logo on card, Thick cut. Tags: sticker, holographic, foil, die-cut, interactive, hover, rainbow, sparkle, iridescent.
- `sticker-cutout` (shader) Any picture or SVG with transparency turned into a still die-cut sticker: its own colours inside a white border grown from its outline, a soft drop shadow, a gloss band and, if wanted, a touch of holographic foil. Made for dropping artwork into a page or scene. Takes image, svg, text, mask. Overlay. Presets: Logo, Holo heart, Word on a card. Tags: sticker, die-cut, static, cutout, border, shadow, gloss, artwork, svg, logo.
- `sticker-peel-reveal` (shader) A picture peels back like a sticker from its bottom-right corner, rolling diagonally over itself with a curl highlight and shadow, to reveal a second picture underneath. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress. Takes image, video, svg. Video: transition. Presets: Tight curl, Kraft backing. Tags: sticker, transition, peel, curl, page, image, reveal.
- `sticker-slap` (vector) A die-cut sticker with a label that flicks up and slaps back down from big with a twist, overshooting and settling as its shadow tightens; every click slaps it again.
